item.title: [Searchlight Pictures] SUPER TROOPERS 3 | Official Trailer | Searchlight Pictures
item.description:
Everyone’s favorite cops are back with the third installment of the cult comedy classic from the Broken Lizard crew: Super Troopers 3. When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

Directed by: Jay Chandrasekhar
Written by: Broken Lizard
Produced by: Rich Perello
Cast: Jay Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter, Erik Stolhanske, Brian Cox, Marisa Coughlan, Nat Faxon, Chace Crawford, Andrew Dismukes, Hannah Simone, Iqbal Theba, Sakina Jaffrey, Jon Rudnitsky, and Lisa Gilroy

item.title: [Park Circus] Twinless | UK & Ireland Official Trailer | Park Circus - In Cinemas 6 February
item.description:
Starring Dylan O'Brien and James Sweeney, TWINLESS is exclusively in cinemas across the UK & Ireland from 6 February 2026.

"A true original" – The Guardian
"One-of-a-kind" – Variety

After meeting in a twin bereavement support group, Roman (Dylan O'Brien) and Dennis (James Sweeney) develop an unlikely bromance as they both search for solace and an identity without their better halves. They soon become inseparable, but old wounds reopen that will have permanent consequences for their friendship. Lauren Graham and Aisling Franciosi also star in this stirring, whip-smart, wholly original dark-comedy from breakout multi hyphenate director James Sweeney.

#Twinless

item.title: [Park Circus] Sunset Boulevard: 75th Anniversary 4K Restoration | Official Trailer | Park Circus
item.description:
Get ready for your close-up... To celebrate its 75th anniversary, Billy Wilder's Academy Award®-winning Hollywood masterpiece SUNSET BOULEVARD returns to cinemas across the UK, Ireland and selected international territories from 5 December 2025 in a spectacular new 4K restoration.

The theatrical re-release follows the world premiere of the new 4K restoration at this year's Cannes Film Festival in May. Check local listings for tickets and showtimes.

Don't let the pictures get small... see it on the big screen!

--

Meticulously restored in 4K from rare archival elements, Sunset Boulevard returns with unmatched visual clarity and a newly expanded 5.1 sound mix. Utilising cutting-edge audio technology and decades-old prints, this restoration honours every frame of Billy Wilder’s masterpiece.

#SunsetBoulevard #SunsetBlvd #4KRestoration
